done_when: package-lock.json resolves axios to 1.20.0 or later and the image scan passes

findings.body: The lockfile resolves axios to 1.20.0, but the required image-scan pass has not been demonstrated. The supplied close run executes npm checks and tests; it does not build the runtime image or run the Trivy step in `.github/workflows/image.yml`. Run that image workflow against this change and confirm its vulnerability scan passes before marking the fix done.
findings.title: Not done: package-lock.json resolves axios to 1.20.0 or later and the image scan passes

why: The image scan fails on new high-severity axios advisories pulled in by the Slack SDK
